findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, get_deadline_satisfaction_mapping, get_prosecution_document, search · Private data: analyze_prosecution_history, analyze_ttab_proceeding, count_trademarks_by_attributes, fetch, get_chain_of_title, get_firm_correspondent_tasks, get_latest_office_action, get_mark_international_profile, get_mark_prosecution_summary, get_owner_related_parties, get_owner_ttab_stats, get_prosecution_document, get_ttab_document, get_ttab_proceeding_details, list_prosecution_documents, lookup_trademark, run_knockout_search, search, search_attorneys, search_design_codes, search_mark_statements, search_trademarks · Public sink: get_deadline_satisfaction_mapping · Destructive: run_knockout_search, run_safe_analytics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, get_deadline_satisfaction_mapping, get_prosecution_document, search · Private data: analyze_prosecution_history, analyze_ttab_proceeding, count_trademarks_by_attributes, fetch, get_chain_of_title, get_firm_correspondent_tasks, get_latest_office_action, get_mark_international_profile, get_mark_prosecution_summary, get_owner_related_parties, get_owner_ttab_stats, get_prosecution_document, get_ttab_document, get_ttab_proceeding_details, list_prosecution_documents, lookup_trademark, run_knockout_search, search, search_attorneys, search_design_codes, search_mark_statements, search_trademarks · Public sink: get_deadline_satisfaction_mapping · Destructive: run_knockout_search, run_safe_analytics
